noise_6step_check.diagnosis: NO_NOISE. Auto verdict IMPULSE is a known false positive: extreme_pct=59.44%>50% while noise_prior sigma<5 (SKILL documented JPEG/blur artifact FP). spatial_corr=0.9514 and cross_ch_corr=0.9903 with rgb_ratio=1.0178 indicate structured glass-shuffle mismatch residual, not independent random noise. Control test blur_glass:2+noise_gaussian_RGB:1 collapsed PSNR 30.25->24.63 dB and CI 10/10->3/10, confirming no random noise in target. Raw-step2 YCrCb verdict (cross_ch=0.9875, ric=-0.528) is also structured-residual FP.

final_decision.rationale: Single-step glass blur sev2. glass_score=0.468>0.25 (pixel-shuffle high-frequency signature), gm_ratio=0.504, spectral_slope_ratio=1.107; PCA=1.078<2.5 and FFT=2.174<2.2 exclude motion. Pair0: glass:2 PSNR=30.25dB CI=10/10 with all CI metric diffs <=0.001 (overshoot/zero-crossing/hf-lf exact), severity scan optimum at sev2 (sev1 28.93, sev3 27.27). Cross-family worse: gaussian:2 29.19 (CI 8/10), lens:2 28.90 (CI 9/10), motion:3 21.75. JPEG control (glass:2+jpeg:1) -> 29.46/CI 7/10 (block_boundary err 66%) confirms NO_COMPRESSION. Noise control -> 24.63/CI 3/10 confirms NO_NOISE. Glass random pixel shuffle limits PSNR (SKILL C.4); 5/5 pairs CI 10/10 constitutes sufficient indicator evidence (SKILL D.4), hence LIKELY.
